text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Over the weekend, hearing that 
traditional dancing would be featured 
at the Cherry Blossom Festival, I went to 
observe with Mayano Top Gun. 
It was all for reference on her Goshiki 
Shuntaisai Votive Dance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—The dance is over on that stage... Huh? 
It's Laurel-san!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're at the Cherry Blossom Festival too, 
Laurel-san? 
Wait, you're wearing traditional clothes! 
So cuuute~♡

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you♪ 
I'm actually lending a helping hand with 
the upcoming dance. 
My role is to hand props to the dancers.
choice_data_list: Oh, so you're going up on the stage!
Oh, so you're going up on the stage!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll merely be standing off in the corner, 
though. 
Still, the dance is truly breathtaking, 
well worth watching♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Props in hand, Sakura Laurel remained 
standing at the corner 
of the stage for the entire performance. 
She was simply standing there, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Laurel-san looks so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why. This feeling... 
It's the same as that mature woman's 
dance...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So dignified—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I get it! That 'dignified feeling'! 
Maybe that's the key to dancing 
like a real mature woman—?!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh~...? Hmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mayano? You look quite troubled. 
...Were you watching Laurel?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai. ...Hey, Laurel-san has this 
super dignified, mature woman vibe, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: How do you think someone gets that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The secret behind Laurel's 
dignified presence, you say? 
If that's what you mean—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Tucking your feelings deep inside your 
heart without showing them. 
Perhaps that inner fortitude is what 
manifests 
as such exquisite beauty.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hiding your feelings? 
What does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Laurel never lets her smile fade, does 
she? 
She never laments her circumstances, nor 
does she utter complaints.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yet due to the fragility of her legs, she 
reportedly 
couldn't train to her heart's content for 
a very long time. 
Deep down... she must have felt incredible 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
On top of that... she was forced to pass 
up on 
the once-in-a-lifetime races she had set 
her sights upon.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Maya remembers that too. 
She seemed all set to race, but then 
couldn't... 
Yet Laurel-san acted just like she always 
does.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She wore a smile. 
Even though she must have wanted to scream 
in regret...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Locking her bitter feelings away in her 
chest, ever forward-looking... 
and dignified. A true hallmark of a 
'mature woman,' wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That makes so much sense! 
It's that dignified strength that makes 
Laurel-san so...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She's dignified because she keeps her 
feelings tucked away. 
In that case, if Maya keeps her feelings 
tucked away too—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I can just hide my feelings for 
Trainer, 
it ought to work the same way!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, let's break into 
individual practice from here.
choice_data_list: I wonder whose support I should join...
I wonder whose support I should join...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trai—! ...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Close one! I'm supposed to keep my 
feelings secret! 
I wanna practice together, but I gotta 
stay quiet here...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you have a moment to spare, 
would you mind observing my mounted 
archery?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Eeeh?! No way...! 
B-But a mature woman's gotta hold it in... 
hold it in...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't check my own posture 
and arrow trajectory by myself, so—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, never mind after all. 
Mayano is making quite the face. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...Did it show on Maya's face? 
Which means I totally didn't keep my 
feelings secret!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the lunch break, Mayano Top Gun 
came over 
and simply stood in silence without doing 
anything.
choice_data_list: ...? Are you sure you don't need anything?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nope! Don't mind Maya at all!
choice_data_list: (? Maybe she just came to take a break...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, I decided to return to my work. 
Referencing yesterday's training data, 
I reviewed today's regimen.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer looks so serious... 
Working so hard for Maya's sake. That 
makes me so happy♪)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...I wanna say how happy I am. 
But... this time, I really gotta keep my 
feelings inside!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(I'll just savor all this happiness 
in secret, all to myself... Ehehe♪)
choice_data_list:
...Dance practice? Want me to put on some 
music?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
!? No, that's not it! 
Wait, was Maya fidgeting around like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm super glad you noticed, but... 
I'm not keeping my feelings tucked away at 
aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm definitely gonna master it! And 
make that dignified, 
mature woman vibe totally mine, just you 
wait!
